subject: SummitForge plugin certification & LangChain adapter review
messages:
From: Eli Torres <eli.torres@summitforge.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: partnerships@summitforge.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: SummitForge LangChain plugin - certification interest

Hi Olga —

Hope you’re well. I’m Eli (Head of Partnerships) at SummitForge. We built an opinionated LangChain extension (SummitChain) that adds tracing hooks and a compact prompt cache tailored for multi-tenant SaaS apps. Several mutual customers asked whether SummitForge can be officially certified on Redwood’s hosted and dedicated runtimes.

High-level ask: are you accepting ISV certs for LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters? If so, we’d like to start a validation/certification process and map out the sequence (security questionnaire, sandbox test, SOW for co-marketing).

Quick context:
- SummitChain v1.4 supports tracing hooks that emit OTEL-compatible spans and an optional token-level attribution header.
- We have a small compatibility shim for Redwood’s streaming API (alpha).

I attached a short proposal and a draft SOW. Would love to schedule a 30-min intro next week. Calendly: https://calendly.com/eli-t/summitforge-redwood

Attachments: [attachment: summitforge-adapter-proposal.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Thanks —
Eli Torres
Head of Partnerships, SummitForge
eli.torres@summitforge.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Eli Torres <eli.torres@summitforge.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SummitForge LangChain plugin - certification interest

Eli — thanks for the note and the proposal. We’re definitely interested in formalizing a certification path for ISV adapters that touch LangChain/LlamaIndex and tracing.

Proposed next steps (one-pager):
1) Security & compliance intake — I’m attaching our standard questionnaire; please return it with evidence for SOC2 / encryption / keys.
2) Technical compatibility review — set up a sandbox instance and provide a short test plan (we’ll run perf and tracing checks).
3) Legal / SOW — review and finalize the co-marketing SOW you attached.
4) Certification sign-off & listing — once we pass, we’ll add SummitForge to our ISV catalog and publish a short integration guide.

Can you complete the questionnaire by 11/10? I’ll loop in Vanessa (partnerships) and Markus (solutions eng) to coordinate the sandbox. I attached the questionnaire and a template NDA for legal to speed things up.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood-security-questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [attachment: Redwood-ISV-NDA-template.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Business Development — ISV Alliances
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

From: Eli Torres <eli.torres@summitforge.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@summitforge.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SummitForge LangChain plugin - certification interest

Hi Olga — thanks for the clear plan. We’ll aim for the 11/10 questionnaire target. I’ve uploaded the draft SOW and a short technical appendix (see attachment). A couple of notes:
- We’ve flagged two items for the technical sandbox: streaming latency under 200ms p50 and preservation of token-level attribution in multi-tenant contexts.
- Legal is OK with the NDA template in principle; they’ll propose a few minor edits.

Attachments: [attachment: SF-Redwood-SOW-v1.pdf (application/pdf)], [attachment: summitforge-technical-appendix.txt (text/plain)]

Would 11/12 at 10:00 PT work for a 45-min technical kickoff? Zoom link pending — I can create once you confirm.

Cheers,
Eli

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Eli Torres <eli.torres@summitforge.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: SummitForge certification — mutual action plan (requested)

Vanessa / Markus / Marissa — looping you in to coordinate SummitForge (external) on a certification path. Quick summary from Eli: SummitForge has a LangChain extension that emits OTEL spans, a prompt cache, and a streaming shim. They want Redwood certification for Hosted + Dedicated.

Proposed mutual action plan and owners:
- Security intake (Olga): send questionnaire (done) — target 11/10 for return.
- Legal redlines (Vanessa): review NDA/SOW and propose edits by 11/15.
- Sandbox & technical eval (Markus): provision sandbox, validate streaming p50 <200ms, validate tracing spans and token attribution behavior. Deliverables: perf summary + trace capture by 11/19.
- Integration doc (Marissa): draft guide for developer portal and sample LangChain adapter snippet for Redwood SDK. Target 11/24.

Markus — can you confirm sandbox sizing & whether you need container image or repo access? Also note we should track testing in HubSpot: deal SF-2027-0412.

Thanks — please reply with conflicts or updates.

Olga
Head of Business Development — ISV Alliances
Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Eli Torres <eli.torres@summitforge.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SummitForge certification — mutual action plan (requested)

Olga / team / Eli — I can handle the sandbox and the technical eval. A few technical notes and asks up front:

1) Sandbox requirements: we’ll spin up a Dedicated-like sandbox (2xA10G equiv) with a tracing collector endpoint. We’ll need either:
   - a public container image with the SummitChain adapter + test harness OR
   - short-lived repo access (token) so our infra can build the adapter against the latest LangChain/Redwood SDK.

2) Tracing details: we’ll capture OTEL spans and correlate them to request IDs. Please confirm whether SummitForge emits both span and attributes for token-level attribution or only headers. The eval will check span shapes and baggage.

3) Compatibility hooks: a) streaming transforms must not block Redwood’s token-level streaming chunking, b) the adapter must respect Redwood's retry/fallback headers. We’ll run a small battery of regression tests.

4) Logs & retention: for the sandbox, we keep logs for 30 days. If SummitForge needs longer retention for debugging, state that in the questionnaire.

Timelines look fine; I’ll provision the environment and send credentials once I have the image or repo access.

—Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Eli
